scripts.check: svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json && npm run check:e2e
scripts.i18n:extract: node scripts/i18n/babel.mjs extract && node scripts/i18n/extract-rust.mjs && node scripts/i18n/generate-web.mjs --extract
scripts.i18n:update: npm run --silent i18n:extract && node scripts/i18n/babel.mjs update && node scripts/i18n/generate-rust.mjs --seed-german && node scripts/i18n/generate-rust.mjs && node scripts/i18n/generate-web.mjs --update
scripts.i18n:compile: node scripts/i18n/babel.mjs compile && node scripts/i18n/generate-rust.mjs && node scripts/i18n/generate-web.mjs
scripts.i18n:check: node scripts/i18n/check-translations.mjs && node scripts/i18n/generate-rust.mjs --check && node scripts/i18n/generate-web.mjs --check
